sentence: This project studies how microorganisms break down different types of organic matter when oxygen levels are low.
This project studies how droplets that change shape steer the internal organization of liquid crystals.
This project builds a cybersecurity program that uses data science methods and tools.
This project studies how public engagement can help build a more inclusive culture in the field of genetics.
This project studies how wearable sensors and artificial intelligence can measure recovery in patients with neurologic motor disorders.
This project builds a mathematical theory that links random matrices with optimal transport.
This project develops educational tools for the engineering curriculum in emerging technology fields.
This project builds soft robots that can change shape and navigate both land and water without being tethered.
This project tries to make stable, thin layered nitride materials and find out how their atomic structure controls their stability.
This project builds a quantum memory in diamond that stores multiple optical photons in a single nuclear spin.
This project builds a system for training graph neural networks on large data from sensors in different spatial locations.
This project studies how mobile fragments of DNA change the rice genome and its epigenome.
This project develops testing methods that produce consistent conclusions about the performance of systems.
This project studies the energetic demands of large carnivorous mammals using energetic, behavioral and movement data.
This project develops learning tools about quantum information science and technology for undergraduate courses.
This project studies how circadian clock components change gene expression and metabolism in early frog development.
This project builds a method that lets a robot estimate what a user's muscles and nervous system are doing using only touch.
This project studies how peroxy radicals react in the air and how those reactions form secondary organic aerosol.
